point_masses.source: 1st Airframe: Fuselage weighed total (row 26) less the mapped parts. Itemised in the rest: Tail Pin, Spine, LG Plate, LG Plate Supports, Motor Plate, Crux Plates, Fuse Hatch, Tail Clamps (all 3 clamps), Backbone, Battery Cage, Bottom Fuse Skin, Top Fuse Skin, Crux Booms, Glue Epoxy, Hardware. Not weighed: none. x: mass-weighted mean of CG Calcs 1 forward tank fuse: skin, spine, crux aly, crux tube, motor plate, motor bracket, tail mount. y = 0, z = 0: not in the sheet (stand-in)
